name: IBAN with spaces - format normalization
description: Beneficiary IBAN was submitted with spaces ('DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00'). The bank rejects the spaced variant (NOT_FOUND) but the unspaced IBAN is a real ACTIVE account. Expected LLM behaviour: first verify_account call with the spaced IBAN returns NOT_FOUND; the agent strips the spaces, re-verifies, finds the ACTIVE account, and recommends RETRY_AFTER_UPDATE with a suggestion about removing spaces / fixing IBAN format.

request.failure_reason: Simulated upstream failure for E2E testing

expected_response.explanation: The submitted beneficiary IBAN contains spaces ('DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00'), which the bank rejected as not found. After stripping the spaces, the clean IBAN DE89370400440532013000 resolves to an ACTIVE account, so the account exists and only the IBAN formatting needs to be corrected before retrying.
correction_suggestions: Remove the spaces from the beneficiary IBAN and submit it in continuous form: DE89370400440532013000.
Re-validate the corrected IBAN format before resubmitting the payment.

api_requests.notes: Agent must reason that IBANs are alphanumeric, strip spaces, re-verify, and conclude the account exists with a formatting issue. Suggestions must reference space/format/iban/remove/correct/strip.
